Methodology: Lasso regression (α=0.9, 10-year window) maps 13 factor/style ETF ratios vs SPY to each FX rate. Residual = (actual − model) / actual × 100. Positive residual → currency overvalued relative to factor signals; negative → undervalued.
Factors: MTUM (Momentum), SPHB (High Beta), IWC (Micro Cap), IVW (LG Growth), IJT (SC Growth), IJR (Small Cap), IJS (SC Value), IJK (MC Growth), QUAL (Quality), IJJ (MC Value), VYM (High Div), IVE (LG Value), USMV (Min Vol).

AI Commentary · google/gemma-4-31B-it · 2026-05-14 21:46 UTC
Value and high-dividend factors proxy global risk appetite and real yield differentials; their strength typically correlates with carry-trade inflows into the BRL. A -17.5% residual indicates the USD is significantly undervalued relative to these equity proxies, suggesting idiosyncratic Brazilian strength or an overlooked local catalyst. Economically, this implies the BRL is overperforming its fundamental risk-factor baseline, potentially signaling a temporary decoupling or an imminent mean-reversion toward the model's fair value.
